svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Quadratic twists of one elliptic curve: E = 11a1, y² + y = x³ − x² − 10x − 20
Each tile is a squarefree twist parameter d with |d| ≤ 100. Its colour is the analytic rank of the twist E⁽ᵈ⁾ (order of vanishing of L at s = 1).
Share of twists by analytic rank, against the theorem's limit
Rank 2 occurs 145 times and rank 3 occurs 5 times. The theorem says this share tends to 0,
but at this height it is still about 6%: density zero is a statement about the limit.
Mean analytic rank: 0.626 (the companion paper: tends to 1/2)
Root numbers: +1 for 49.7%, −1 for 50.3% of these d
The root number is the parity of the analytic rank, so it splits the family into
an even half (ranks 0, 2, …) and an odd half (ranks 1, 3, …).
Computed with PARI/GP 2.17.2 (ellanalyticrank, ellrootno); numerical, not certified.
